intent: HistoryEntry is the immutable history value: natural identity session id + turn id + entry sequence, kind user message|tool call|assistant reply, content, token count, recorded timestamp. Every entry carries a token count; blank identifiers, null kind or content and a negative count or sequence are refused. Pure Java, no framework types, never updated.

methods.signature: HistoryEntry(String sessionId, String turnId, int entrySequence, String kind, String content, int tokenCount, Instant recordedAt)
methods.semantics: rejects blank sessionId/turnId, null kind/content/recordedAt, negative entrySequence or tokenCount
